source.interpretation: MINBS on a basic ONDEM TransportPolicyProfile row is the number of demands required to start a transport. The default/one threshold permits immediate dispatch; two should hold the first same-link demand until the second, then start one two-item batch. The manual says all items and systems using the same transport data on this link count together; mixed-item scope requires separate evidence.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Derive both arms from accepted E10.var01 ONDEM. Port accepted E03's two-aircraft, simultaneous h8 two-mission demand pattern by changing only System/Item FRT 300000->3000000, SystemDeployment QTYPS 1->2 and OperationProfile to one scheduled h8 row IQTY2; set depot opening LRU stock 1->2 and change description. Keep all E10 transport, station, repair, resource, seed and horizon configuration otherwise fixed.

The two frozen arms differ only in description and one basic ONDEM TransportPolicyProfile MINBS value 1 versus 2. Both must produce exactly two distinct physical same-IID spare demands on the same depot-to-base transport link under seed1; if the demand-generating model does not do so, classify this frozen candidate NO-GO rather than infer batching from a single request.

In MINBS=1, each demand should be eligible for immediate downward dispatch. In MINBS=2, the first demand must remain queued without a physical downward departure until the second demand is counted; then one transport carrying two distinct physical spare IDs should start and arrive after the fixed two-hour transport time. An early single-item departure or two separate MINBS=2 departures is NO-GO.

Reconcile each failed item, physical depot stock withdrawal, request, transport attachment/start/arrival, local backorder/clearance, repair/restock, mission result, all 72 half-hour SystemResults and StockTotalResults bins, any resource rows or absence thereof, and terminal depot/base stock, in-transit state, backorders and aircraft readiness for both arms. Do not treat aggregate report similarity alone as batching evidence.

Run each frozen arm through guarded session-0 SSH under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue with fresh IDs; preserve GUI PID13340 identity; require zero conversion errors, nonempty SXO/log/JSON report, exact authored-table roundtrip, source/raw SHA-256 seals and separate independent read-only replay without importing the author's checker.
limits: This package tests only two demands for the same item type on one general downward link and a single fixed seed. It does not test mixed items or systems sharing transport data, cross-link pooling, three-or-more thresholds, end-of-horizon partial batches, GUI visuals or cross-engine parity.
Full E10, E11 and Issue #18 remain open; mixed-item E10.var06 coverage requires a later bounded supplement.
